explication: LX Music Sync Server combines a multi-source web music player with a user/device synchronization server and management console. The main user flow is browser search or playlist selection, server-side music-source resolution, then playback or download; separately, LX Music clients connect to synchronize user lists and dislikes. The README also documents Subsonic access, custom sources, shared public collections, and WebDAV backup. The graph uses documented capabilities and sampled API interactions; unsampled route wiring is represented only where the README supports it.
